title: Keep coins in a wallet
objective: Use a class with a field and a method to keep a running count across several calls.

body.text: A class keeps its own data between calls. Here a wallet has a coins field that starts at 0, and an add method that increases it. Each call to add changes the same object, so the total builds up over the program.

body.title: Add coins to a wallet
body.code:
class wallet
    has coins of type number
    construction
        set coins of myself to 0
    can add
        takes number called amount
        increase coins of myself by amount

make w equal to a new wallet
add 8 to w
add 4 to w
say coins of w

body.prompt: The wallet holds 10 coins, but it should hold 15. Make it print 15.
